description: This source file defines a Roslyn diagnostic analyzer for the Orleans project, specifically for analyzing class, struct, record, and record struct declarations to ensure they have appropriate serialization attributes. It reports diagnostics if certain conditions are not met regarding serialization attribute configurations.

classes.name: GenerateSerializationAttributesAnalyzer
classes.description: A diagnostic analyzer for verifying serialization attributes on types in Orleans.

methods.name: CheckSyntaxNode
methods.description: Analyzes syntax nodes representing types to verify the presence and configuration of serialization attributes.

methods.name: GetGenerateFieldIdsValue
methods.description: Parses attribute arguments to determine the specified GenerateFieldIds value.
